newsitem.title: UK: LME lead jumps in after-hours trading.
newsitem.headline: LME lead jumps in after-hours trading.

text.p: LME lead flipped higher by nearly $20 in late inter-office trading on Thursday evening when stops were hit in a thin market, traders said.
At 1900 GMT, three months lead was indicated at $692/$695 per tonne, compared to a $675 kerb close.
Lead ended the kerb with a gain of $10 on the day and just above the top of a range that has held for the past week.
"Stops, which were mostly from the states, were hit in a thin market...Personally, I think it overshot itself," a trader said.
The other metals were little changed with copper indicated at $2,390/94 versus a $2,393 close on the kerb and aluminium at $1,649/51 compared to $1,652.
